summary: Iteration 19 verification of 5 bug fixes (PIN reset via call/SMS.ru, DELETE user endpoint, mobile admin drawer, wider container, wider admin). Backend 9/10 passed, 1 skipped (customer-token-cannot-delete test skipped because test_mode=false in prod so a customer token could not be easily obtained; the harder 'no-token' variant passed with 401/403). Frontend E2E all green: (a) admin desktop layout (1440x900) — .admin-sidebar visible (256px), .admin-topbar display:none, .admin-container maxWidth=1536px (96rem); (b) admin mobile (390x844) — topbar display=flex, sidebar closed by default (left=-272px), admin-burger click adds 'open' class to sidebar, backdrop click closes it; (c) DELETE user flow via UI end-to-end — Edit button on TEST_DEL_UI passenger row opened edit modal with data-testid=delete-user-btn, clicking it opened data-testid=delete-user-modal with cancel/confirm buttons, cancel closed the modal, confirm made DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} request and the row was removed from the list (verified request URL + DOM); (d) /auth/customer desktop container = 768px (48rem) for both .app-container and .bottom-sheet; (e) PinScreen forgot-pin flow — with seed customer that had has_pin=true, clicking data-testid=forgot-pin-btn triggered callcheck/start with purpose=pin_reset and rendered data-testid=pin-reset-call screen with title 'Подтверждение номера телефона', call_phone '8-800-777-9999', 4 .call-digit-box empty digit slots, timer 'Осталось времени', and tel: call-to-action link. Backend pytest verified: pin_reset for existing customer returns method='call' AND callcheck_requests document has purpose='pin_reset' stored (so confirm will clear pin_hash); new-phone customer returns method='call'; role='driver' returns method='sms' only; second callcheck/start on the same phone returns 429 with detail 'RATE_LIMIT:N'; DELETE with no token → 401; DELETE customer → success + orders_deleted count + full cleanup (user, orders, notifications, callcheck_requests); DELETE driver → user removed and driver_id set to None in his orders (orders preserved); DELETE admin → 403 'Нельзя удалить администратора'; DELETE nonexistent → 404 'Пользователь не найден'. Settings were snapshotted and restored (call_verify_enabled preserved).

minor.issue: Admin settings routes live at /api/settings/ (settings_router), not /api/admin/settings. First iteration of the pytest fixture used the wrong path and got 404. Not a bug — just a discoverability gotcha for external testers/documenters (all other admin routes are under /api/admin/*). LOW — recommend either alias or documentation.

Rate-limit check uses last callcheck_requests document by phone alone (line 893), but the record is only inserted after successful sms.ru upstream call (line 918). If upstream fails and returns method='sms', no row is inserted → no rate-limit is consumed. Two devices racing within rate_limit_seconds could both trigger real sms.ru calls if the first upstream response times out. LOW — matches iter 18 remark, not a regression.

issues: When admin-topbar is on top, the passengers table wraps in .admin-table-wrap and horizontal-scrolls. Works, but on tiny phones the ⓘ/✎ action buttons are far to the right — user must swipe. Consider using card-list mode below md.
The row-level Edit2 icon button in the passengers table has no data-testid (only title='Редактировать'). Adding data-testid='edit-user-btn' would make future automated regression easier. LOW.

action_items: OPTIONAL — add data-testid='edit-user-btn' to the row-level Edit2 button in AdminPanel.js line 944 (passengers/drivers list) for parity with delete-user-btn.
OPTIONAL — document that admin settings endpoints are at /api/settings/ (not /api/admin/settings) OR add an alias route under /api/admin/settings for consistency with the rest of admin surface.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1923-1961 (delete_user) — good: caller admin id logged, cascade covers orders/logs/notifications/verification_codes/callcheck_requests, driver orders preserve driver_id=null. Consider also deleting user_devices/pushtokens rows if such collections exist (search grep didn't show explicit cleanup). LOW.

AdminPanel.js:437-449 (handleDeleteUser) — uses window.confirm/alert() for pre-check + result which cannot be data-testid'd; the modal you already render (delete-user-modal) makes window.confirm redundant. Consider removing native confirm/alert in favor of custom modal + toast for consistent UX and easier testing. MED.

PinScreen.js:98-125 (handleForgotPin) — silent fallback to SMS when callcheck/start returns method='sms' or throws. Consider a subtle 'Отправляем SMS…' state when this happens so user knows the flow switched. LOW.

PinScreen.js:144-160 poll — while polling, if user closes the browser and reopens, the poll interval doesn't resume (callData in state only). If SMS.ru completes and the record status flips to confirmed on server, the user can't recover the flow on new device (callcheck/status requires matching device_id per line 951). LOW.

AdminPanel.js — no explicit lg breakpoint enforcement in JSX; sidebar drawer relies on CSS media queries in index.css (~L780-855). This is fine but a `useMediaQuery` hook or a matchMedia listener would give a cleaner conditional render of admin-topbar. STYLISTIC.

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10 passed, 1 skipped due to test_mode=false — no failures)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all layouts, drawer, delete flow, container width and PIN-reset call screen verified

Admin settings snapshot restored via pytest module fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_pin_reset_delete.py — self-restoring via module fixture; requires MONGO_URL env for pymongo cleanup. Run with: MONGO_URL='mongodb://localhost:27017' DB_NAME='test_database' REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL='...' pytest ... . SMS.ru upstream currently works (returned call_phone 8-800-777-9999). If sms.ru rate-limit-hour hits, tests fall through to method='sms' branch and rate-limit test is skipped. NOTE: admin settings route is /api/settings/ (with trailing slash) NOT /api/admin/settings. NOTE: PinScreen requires localStorage keys taxi_pin_phone + taxi_pin_role set before /auth/pin route is loaded (otherwise redirects to /). test_mode=false in production — cannot use SMS code 1234 shortcut for a customer login token without flipping test_mode.
rca of the issue: All 5 reported bugs verified fixed. (1) callcheck/start with purpose='pin_reset' now works for existing customers — server.py:870-940 removed the earlier 'existing_user' guard, added purpose param stored in callcheck_requests; callcheck/status:1022-1026 handles purpose=='pin_reset' by unsetting pin_hash and setting has_pin=false, then re-issuing a fresh token. PinScreen.js:91-136 wires this into the 'Забыли код?' path. (2) .app-container max-width is now 48rem (768px) at ≥768px breakpoint (verified 768px width at 1440x900 viewport). (3) AdminPanel now has data-testid=admin-burger + admin-topbar + drawer sidebar with backdrop; verified on 390x844. (4) DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} exists (server.py:1923-1961) with proper cascade + admin-guard + 404; UI has delete-user-btn, delete-user-modal, cancel-delete-user, confirm-delete-user testids; DELETE API call captured during E2E and row was removed. (5) .admin-container max-width is now 96rem (1536px verified) — fields have room.
